usedFor: PollPe collects form answers and HubSpot holds your contacts, so “Form Submitted” can run “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Form Submitted” in PollPe, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each respondent becomes a HubSpot contact, so survey answers reach sales without copy and paste.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so the PollPe form must ask for one.
